newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 9.

text.p: The following stories were reported in Wednesday's Daily Variety:

* Sony Pictures Entertainment of Sony Corp announced a new management team including president and chief operating officer, John Calley, co-president Jeff Sagansky and executive vice president Yuki Nozoe.
* Kirk Kerkorian, Australia's Seven Network Ltd and Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer Inc Chairman Frank Mancuso already face scepticism about their plans for MGM.
* News Corp said it will file suit Wednesday against Time Warner Inc, Turner Broadcasting System Inc and Ted Turner. The suit will charge all three with antitrust violations.
* Trimark Holdings Inc has entered into a commitment with Chase Manhattan Corp to arrange a $75 million syndicated revolving credit agreement.
* Sony Corp's Mandalay Entertainment is close to finalizing a revolving credit facility for as much as $100 million from Coutts & Co of National Westminster Bank Plc.
